events.title: A voice in the ice
events.text: A deep crack travels through the glacier. You hold still until the last echo fades; no snow falls from the face above.
events.summary: You listened to the glacier settle.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You listened to the glacier settle.

events.title: Under the crust
events.text: Beneath a cloudy sheet of ice, water threads between dark stones. A hare has crossed here, leaving prints that stop at the exposed bank.
events.summary: You found hare tracks beside the meltwater.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found hare tracks beside the meltwater.

events.title: Blue light
events.text: Light passes through the ice above a shallow hollow. You watch your shadow turn blue against the wall, then stretch back towards the entrance.
events.summary: You paused in the blue light of the caves.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You paused in the blue light of the caves.

events.title: A loose stone
events.text: A pebble turns beneath your paw and rattles down the slope. Far below, a small shape bolts between the rocks before you can catch its scent.
events.summary: You startled a small animal on the scree.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You startled a small animal on the scree.

events.title: The other side
events.text: At the crest, the wind flattens your whiskers. Beyond the pass lies another stretch of the Vale, its trails too distant to make out.
events.summary: You looked across the Vale from North Pass.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You looked across the Vale from North Pass.

events.title: Worn stone
events.text: The sheltered lip of a cave is smooth where generations of cats have passed. You stop short of the entrance; fresh scent lies over the old.
events.summary: You found fresh scent at a Highcrag cave.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found fresh scent at a Highcrag cave.

events.title: Heads raised
events.text: Horses stand among the cropped grass. One lifts its head, then another, until the whole group is watching your patch of hillside.
events.summary: You watched the meadow horses notice you.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You watched the meadow horses notice you.

events.title: A branch goes by
events.text: A stripped branch turns in the current, catches against a stone, then swings free. The water is stronger than it looks from the bank.
events.summary: You watched the strength of the upper river.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You watched the strength of the upper river.

events.title: Overwritten
events.text: Two cat scents overlap on a stone above the crossing. One is fresher, but neither has quite covered the other.
events.summary: You found rival scent marks at the ford.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found rival scent marks at the ford.

events.title: White ground
events.text: Pale crust breaks under your paws. You lower your nose to a shallow hollow, but find only dry earth and the faint tracks of birds.
events.summary: You crossed a dry hollow on the salt flats.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You crossed a dry hollow on the salt flats.

events.title: Between the ribs
events.text: Grass grows through the ribs of an old mammoth. A small bird slips between them, carrying a strand in its beak.
events.summary: You watched a bird among the mammoth bones.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You watched a bird among the mammoth bones.

events.title: Many feet
events.text: Hoofprints press into older hoofprints until the trail is wider than a den. You find a single tuft of coarse fur caught on a low stem.
events.summary: You examined the signs along the herd trail.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You examined the signs along the herd trail.

events.title: At whisker height
events.text: The grass closes around your shoulders. Somewhere ahead, stems tremble in a moving line, then fall still.
events.summary: You followed a movement through the tall grass.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You followed a movement through the tall grass.

events.title: Open country
events.text: From a low rise you can see a long way across the grass. A distant animal moves against the skyline, too far away to name.
events.summary: You surveyed the open southern range.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You surveyed the open southern range.

events.title: A place to sit
events.text: The split in the great boulder holds a narrow strip of shade. Old cat scents mingle at its base, with no single scent strong enough to claim it.
events.summary: You paused beneath the Split Rock.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You paused beneath the Split Rock.

events.title: Two currents
events.text: At the fork, clear ripples meet a cloudy stream. A leaf turns where the waters join before slipping downstream.
events.summary: You watched the currents meet at Twin Forks.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You watched the currents meet at Twin Forks.

events.title: A hidden caller
events.text: A bird calls from deep in the reeds. You turn towards it, but the next call comes from somewhere else among the stems.
events.summary: You listened to an unseen bird in the reeds.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You listened to an unseen bird in the reeds.

events.title: Between the trunks
events.text: Fog fills the gaps between the pines. A deer steps across a narrow trail; by the time you reach it, only the scent remains.
events.summary: You found a deer trail in the Mistwood fog.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found a deer trail in the Mistwood fog.

events.title: Your own tracks
events.text: The path bends around a fallen trunk. On the far side you recognise the prints you left earlier, still sharp in the mud.
events.summary: You recognised your own tracks on the fog paths.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You recognised your own tracks on the fog paths.

events.title: Under the roots
events.text: The roots of a leaning pine hold the soil in a tangled wall. Beneath them, old needles lie dry while the forest floor outside glistens.
events.summary: You found a dry hollow beneath pine roots.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found a dry hollow beneath pine roots.

events.title: Grey ice
events.text: A pale shelf of ice meets open water. A small wave slips underneath it, lifting the edge just enough for you to see it move.
events.summary: You watched the spring ice shift on the Mere.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You watched the spring ice shift on the Mere.

events.title: An old path
events.text: Reeds have grown across a narrow trail to the water. Beneath their bent stems, the earth is still pressed smooth by many paws.
events.summary: You found an overgrown trail beside the Mere.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found an overgrown trail beside the Mere.

events.title: Across the shallows
events.text: A goose stands on a low patch of land among the channels. It stretches its neck towards you and calls until another answers.
events.summary: You heard geese calling across the channels.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You heard geese calling across the channels.

events.title: Across the ridge
events.text: You reach a hollow between two heights. Wind whistles through it, carrying the dry scrape of a stone rolling somewhere out of sight.
events.summary: You listened to loose stone on East Saddle.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You listened to loose stone on East Saddle.

events.title: Heavy scent
events.text: Bear scent hangs in the narrow gorge. You can see where a broad paw has pressed deep into a patch of soft earth.
events.summary: You found a bear print in the narrow gorge.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found a bear print in the narrow gorge.

events.title: A mark above you
events.text: Claw marks run down the rock above your head. You stretch your neck to follow them, then look back along the narrow way you came.
events.summary: You examined high claw marks in Claw Gorge.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You examined high claw marks in Claw Gorge.

events.title: Not water
events.text: The dark surface shines like a still pool, but its smell is thick and bitter. A trapped leaf tilts slowly without drifting towards the edge.
events.summary: You watched a leaf held fast in the tar.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You watched a leaf held fast in the tar.

events.title: Along the ridge
events.text: Wolf tracks follow the crest rather than the hollows. At a scent-marked stone, several sets of prints turn along the same trail.
events.summary: You found a well-used wolf trail in the Ash Hills.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found a well-used wolf trail in the Ash Hills.

events.title: Single file
events.text: The ground is worn into a narrow track. Wolf scent lies along it in layers, some fresh enough to make you lift your head and listen.
events.summary: You noticed fresh scent on the wolf run.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You noticed fresh scent on the wolf run.

events.title: Dry stems
events.text: Old camel tracks cut across the ridge. The plants beside them have been bitten down to woody stems; nothing moves on the slope today.
events.summary: You found old camel tracks on the ridge.

choices.label: Continue
choices.summary: You found old camel tracks on the ridge.

events.title: A measured greeting
events.text: {catName} is standing in the middle of the path, far enough off that you can stop without crowding. That's close enough. On the crag we give our names before we come any nearer. What's yours?
events.summary: You met {catName}.

choices.label: Give your name and wait.
choices.text: {catName} says your name back slowly, getting it right. Good. Then we're not strangers any more. I'll remember that.
choices.summary: You introduced yourself to {catName}.

parts.beat: {catName} says your name back slowly, getting it right.

parts.say: Good. Then we're not strangers any more. I'll remember that.

choices.label: Back off a few steps and say nothing.
choices.text: {catName} watches you back away and doesn't follow. Suit yourself. Next time, start with your name.
choices.summary: You kept your distance from {catName}.

parts.beat: {catName} watches you back away and doesn't follow.

parts.say: Suit yourself. Next time, start with your name.

choices.label: “I don't owe you my name. I'll go where I like.”
choices.text: No, you don't owe me anything. And nobody on the crag owes you a welcome. {catName} turns away with both ears pinned back.
choices.summary: You dismissed {catName}’s greeting.

parts.say: No, you don't owe me anything. And nobody on the crag owes you a welcome.

parts.beat: {catName} turns away with both ears pinned back.
{catName} is standing in the middle of the path, far enough off that you can stop without crowding.

parts.say: That's close enough. On the crag we give our names before we come any nearer. What's yours?

events.speaker: {catId}

events.title: Stand where you are
events.text: {catName} stops a few paces off and looks you up and down. On your own? Then nobody's coming to help you if this goes wrong. Are you going to run?
events.summary: You met {catName}.

choices.label: “I'm not running. I'm on my own, and I can look after myself.”
choices.text: We'll see about that. {catName} looks you over again, slower this time.
choices.summary: You answered {catName} steadily.

parts.say: We'll see about that.

parts.beat: {catName} looks you over again, slower this time.

choices.label: Walk wide around and say nothing.
choices.text: {catName} doesn't budge to let you by. Thought so.
choices.summary: You passed {catName} without speaking.

parts.beat: {catName} doesn't budge to let you by.

parts.say: Thought so.

choices.label: “Big talk from a cat who needs a whole pride behind it.”
choices.text: {catName}'s ears go flat. Say that again and you'll find out how much help I need. Now keep walking.
choices.summary: You mocked {catName} at your first meeting.

parts.beat: {catName}'s ears go flat.

parts.say: Say that again and you'll find out how much help I need. Now keep walking.

parts.beat: {catName} stops a few paces off and looks you up and down.

parts.say: On your own? Then nobody's coming to help you if this goes wrong. Are you going to run?

events.speaker: {catId}

events.title: A voice nearby
events.text: You're very loud, you know. {catName} is standing by a tree, much closer than you'd thought. Sound carries in the fog, and we've had enough trouble. Can you keep it down?
events.summary: You met {catName}.

choices.label: Drop your voice. “Sorry. I'm only passing through.”
choices.text: {catName} listens to the quiet for a moment, then nods. Thank you. We lost a lot of cats in the Breaking, so we keep quiet now.
choices.summary: You gave {catName} time and quiet.

parts.beat: {catName} listens to the quiet for a moment, then nods.

parts.say: Thank you. We lost a lot of cats in the Breaking, so we keep quiet now.

choices.label: Back away quietly and leave the path.
choices.text: {catName} doesn't move until the trees hide you. Go carefully.
choices.summary: You left {catName} space.

parts.beat: {catName} doesn't move until the trees hide you.

parts.say: Go carefully.

choices.label: “I'll walk how I like. Do you lot always hide in the fog?”
choices.text: We hide because we've lost enough cats already. You wouldn't understand that. {catName} slips away between the trunks.
choices.summary: You sneered at {catName}’s caution.

parts.say: We hide because we've lost enough cats already. You wouldn't understand that.

parts.beat: {catName} slips away between the trunks.

parts.say: You're very loud, you know.

parts.beat: {catName} is standing by a tree, much closer than you'd thought.

parts.say: Sound carries in the fog, and we've had enough trouble. Can you keep it down?

events.speaker: {catId}

events.title: Another solitary trail

beats.text: You pick up a scent on the trail: a lone cat, no pride smell on {him}, only dust and old kills. Then {catName} comes out of the brush ahead of you.

parts.beat: You pick up a scent on the trail: a lone cat, no pride smell on {him}, only dust and old kills. Then {catName} comes out of the brush ahead of you.

beats.speaker: {catId}

beats.text: {catName} plants {his} feet in the middle of the path and lets you get a good look at {his} sabers.

parts.beat: {catName} plants {his} feet in the middle of the path and lets you get a good look at {his} sabers.

beats.speaker: {catId}

beats.text: {catName} stops a few lengths away and stays very still, sizing you up.

parts.beat: {catName} stops a few lengths away and stays very still, sizing you up.

beats.speaker: {catId}

beats.text: {catName} stops short and turns partly away, ready to back off if this goes badly.

parts.beat: {catName} stops short and turns partly away, ready to back off if this goes badly.

beats.speaker: {catId}

beats.text: {His} nose is going the whole time, working out where you've been.

parts.beat: {His} nose is going the whole time, working out where you've been.

beats.speaker: {catId}

beats.text: {His} eyes keep going to the bushes, as if {he} thinks something else might jump out.

parts.beat: {His} eyes keep going to the bushes, as if {he} thinks something else might jump out.

beats.speaker: {catId}

beats.text: {catName}'s bobtail flicks up, and {his} whole face brightens. Oh, another loner! I was starting to think nobody else lived out here. Is it just you?

parts.beat: {catName}'s bobtail flicks up, and {his} whole face brightens.

parts.say: Oh, another loner! I was starting to think nobody else lived out here. Is it just you?

beats.speaker: {catId}

parts.beat: {catName} eases down onto the path, stiff in the legs.

parts.say: It's only me, and I'm too old to be any trouble. I used to live on the crag. Are you on your own?

parts.beat: {catName} jumps, then pretends not to have.

parts.say: Oh! Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Not that I'm waiting for anyone. Are you on your own too?

parts.beat: {catName} gives you a long, hard sniff.

parts.say: You don't smell of Bonefield. Lucky for you. On your own, are you?

parts.beat: {catName} looks past you, checking for others.

parts.say: Just you? Good. I'm from Bonefield, and I'm not going back while its leader's in charge. I've still got friends there, so I'd rather you didn't ask why.

parts.beat: {catName} bounces over before you've even stopped.

parts.say: Hey, you're new! I know every scent round here, and not yours. Are you on your own? Me too, mostly.

parts.beat: {catName} peers at you, squinting.

parts.say: Hello, dear. Sorry, my eyes aren't what they were. You're on your own, aren't you? So am I.

parts.beat: {catName} won't meet your eyes.

parts.say: If the Mistwood cats told you about me, it's all true. I don't want trouble. Are you on your own? Then go on past.
Have you seen a cub out here, or smelled a cub anywhere?

parts.beat: {catName} watches your face, then looks away.

parts.say: Never mind. Are you on your own?

parts.beat: {catName} hurries up to you, sniffing.

parts.say: Have you come from the Mistwood? I've been trying to find them since the ice broke. No? Are you on your own, then?

beats.text: {catName} looks you over from ears to bobtail, in no hurry. Just you? Good. I don't like being outnumbered on my own trail.

parts.beat: {catName} looks you over from ears to bobtail, in no hurry.

parts.say: Just you? Good. I don't like being outnumbered on my own trail.

events.text: {catName} steps onto the path. “These are Highcrag trails. Keep clear of the caves.”
